column1: # RWC Part-1 headword glyphs, resolved by reading the headword image itself.
# The book prints every basic character's headword as an image. The prior
# extraction (books/extracted/rwc-entries.jsonl) turned most of them into Unicode,
# but left 33 as `char: null` and misread 11 more as a related character that
# shares the sound or most of the shape (各 as 个, 级 as 及, 苹 as 平, 巳 as 己).
# Two of the first hand resolutions of the nulls were also wrong (470, 482).
# Every row here was checked against the actual headword image in the epub
# (OEBPS/Images/<file>) — the glyph is unambiguous in the stroke-order box beside
# it, and the image also prints the serial.
# This table WINS over the prior extraction: extract-rwc.mjs and
# merge-rwc-shards.mjs take a serial's glyph from here first. The whole of Part 1
# (1,067 images) was audited on 2026-09-28; anything absent here matched.
